report_identity.report_title: China Xinhua Education Group Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides private formal higher and secondary vocational education in the PRC, with revenue mainly from tuition and boarding fees.

segments.name: Private education services
segments.facts: Revenue comprises primarily tuition fees and boarding fees from students.

business_overview.revenue_model: Students generally pay tuition and boarding fees in advance before the academic year or semester; revenue is recognised over the service period.
business_notes: The group says it is a leading private higher education group in China and the largest private higher education provider in the Yangtze River Delta by full-time higher education enrollment.
PRC operating schools and the school sponsor are controlled through structured contracts.
The group had not commenced the private school for-profit/not-for-profit registration process up to the annual report date.
Private schools not requiring reasonable returns must appropriate at least 25% of the annual increase in net assets to a school development fund.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow was higher than profit in 2024 and 2023, helped by prepaid tuition/boarding fees and other payable inflows. Distributability is constrained by PRC education/VIE structure, school development fund rules, continued campus advances and no proposed 2024 final dividend.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and bank deposits by listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, ordinary PRC subsidiaries and VIE/operating schools.
The annual report does not disclose maturity buckets for the RMB548.1 million current bank time deposits.
Only 2024 annual report and its 2023 comparatives were used for cash-flow conversion; a third full year was not re-extracted in this run.
